positions.name: OnboardingProcessAuthority
positions.frame: What grounds the Pallasine checklist's authority as the onboarding standard — its own specification of required steps, or its institutional history of displacing the prior wiki-based practice?
positions.why: Both expressions come from the same speaker (Wren Duskfield) asserting authority-ranking claims about the same governing artifact: src-1 states the checklist's mandatory content as settled fact (legitimate/informational power, universal-mandate framing), src-2 supplies the institutional event that installed it as governing (informational power, one instrument superseding another). Read together, the pair jointly establishes the checklist's legitimacy — current specification plus supersession history — rather than reading as two independent facts.
